name: appfire-agent-governance-lab
description: Appfire Agent Governance: the customer-facing AI agent of the AI-DEMO2 demo with all 87 of its use cases, in eight tracks and eleven verticals (four full packs and seven stubs). A deterministic engine produces every token, hop and decision with no network. The lab opens in Real when Real is fully configured; otherwise no tenant is reached.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
